CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Report

This report assesses the tenant against the Center for Internet Security (CIS) Microsoft 365 Foundations Benchmark using CIPP's built-in CIS test library. Each item below reports Passed, Failed, or Skipped based on the live tenant configuration at run time.

The tests in CIPP currently track CIS Benchmark version 6.0.1. AppliedI also maintains version 7.0.0 standards templates (Level 1 and Level 2) for drift reporting and alerting; the two are complementary. Conditional Access, privileged access management, data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, and the Microsoft Fabric controls are assessed outside this test set.

CIS Benchmarks are published by the Center for Internet Security. This template references CIS control numbers and titles only and does not reproduce the benchmark document.
